explication: Shadowsocks for Windows is a desktop encrypted proxy client. Users configure servers and proxy mode from the tray UI; the controller starts local listeners, accepts SOCKS/HTTP traffic, selects a server, encrypts and relays it, then returns responses to applications. PAC generation and system-proxy integration decide which destinations use the tunnel. The tree and excerpts clearly show orchestration, relay handling, configuration, strategies, and UI; some service-to-service links are inferred from explicit class responsibilities and documented capabilities.
